excluded_phases: TFLite weight parsing and PyTorch model construction
data-file loading and INT8 input dequantization
1,000 untimed complete accuracy-set passes after one shape warmup for each observed batch shape
measurement_protocol.timing_scope: 2,000 repetitions of the complete 1,000-example accuracy set after model, data, and the declared 1,000-pass device warmup are complete

public.rationale: Direct MLPerf Tiny DS-CNN and 1,000-example accuracy-contract adaptation; claims remain withheld because the PyTorch execution is quality-preserving but nonidentical to the pinned LiteRT graph. Promotion requires an exact-source execution path or authoritative unquantized weights, then a fresh five-run sweep.

reviewer_notes: The 90% threshold and 1,000-example MFCC evaluation contract are inherited from MLPerf Tiny.

A full-set LiteRT 2.1.6 audit found 7 of 1,000 top-1 disagreements against XNNPACK and 5 against the builtin kernels. PyTorch scores 90.2%, while LiteRT scores 90.0% and 90.5%, respectively; every path passes the inherited 90% gate, but strict prediction parity is not established.

The review decision classifies the PyTorch conversion as quality-preserving but nonidentical. It remains useful for education, but it is not promotion eligible. Promotion requires exact-source execution or authoritative unquantized weights, followed by a fresh multi-run sweep. No disagreement tolerance is implied.
Each execution performs 1,000 untimed accuracy-set passes to establish a repeatable device state, then measures 2,000 unchanged passes; quality is computed from the first measured pass only.
